items.q: What does a fire AMC include in Sharjah?
items.a: A fire AMC in Sharjah typically includes maintenance of fire alarms, sprinklers, suppression systems, hydrants, hose reels, fire extinguishers, and emergency lighting. Coverage depends on your specific contract.

items.q: Is a fire AMC mandatory in Sharjah?
items.a: Yes. Sharjah Civil Defence requires all commercial and industrial properties to maintain their fire protection systems under a valid maintenance contract with an SCD approved fire contractor.
